sentences.text: Ruthenibacterium lactatiformans is a Gram-stain-negative, rod-shaped, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming and non-motile bacterium of the family Ruminococcaceae.
The strains on which the species was based were isolated from the faeces of healthy human subjects and produce d-lactic acid, succinic acid and acetic acid from glucose fermentation.
A study comparing multiple sclerosis patients with household healthy controls reported a significantly increased proportion of Ruthenibacterium lactatiformans in patients.
A study of rheumatoid arthritis reported significantly lower abundance of Ruthenibacterium lactatiformans in the patient group.
A study of major depressive disorder reported elevated abundance of Ruthenibacterium lactatiformans in the gut microbiota of patients.
